[h1]T-Minus 30 has been updated to V1.03 [/h1]

[b]Updated features:[/b]
- Opening a build menu category now auto-selects the top item in that category.
- Food now shows % of demand met next to quantity.
- Added hotkey L for Lookout Post
- Added hotkey M for Mountain Lookout Post
- Added hotkeys to relevant tooltips.

notes.title: Update Notes for V1.02
notes.content:
- Fixed sound sliders issue where anything less than full volume was really quiet.
- Fixed mouse over water tile text which referred to Water Filter instead of Metal Synthesizer.
- Fixed Reclamation Site placement text which referred to Ruins instead of Skyscraper.
- Fixed issue where you could not place a Water Pump on a shoreline tile next to a Bridge or a Metal Synthesizer.
- Improved Energy Transmitter and Water Tower text to make it clearer that they must be placed *adjacent to* energy/water sources.
- Tweaked Advanced Rocket tutorial to refer to getting minerals from an Advanced Reclamation Site.
- Tweaked Clear tool tutorial to say that only some types of new structures can be cleared.
- Added "and Exploration" to mouse over for Transport category.
- Work color is now a less saturated yellow so it is less distracting when playing.
- Moving work particles are now just a small circle instead of a 3 person icon.
- Added Hotkey C for Clear (pressing it again will toggle it off)
- Added Hotkey R for Road.
